references.text: Theological parallel: Worship of Jesus in the NT as a direct continuation of worship of Yahweh in the OT.
Direct narrative parallel: The servant's identical reaction (worship) on two occasions within the same account.
Theological parallel: Immediate worship as a response to God's revelation/guidance by both Moses and Abraham's servant.
Thematic parallel: Worship as a grateful response to God's fulfillment of a promise.
Theological contrast: The same action (worship) directed toward the wrong object (an idol) versus the right object (the Lord).
Thematic parallel: Collective and individual worship as a response to God's salvation and guidance.
Thematic parallel: Physical expressions of submission and prayer (falling down/bowing) by both Jesus and OT believers.
Theological connection: Psalm 95:6 gives the call to that action (worship/bowing) which is performed in Genesis 24:26.
